description: Identifies user criteria records with Advanced (scripted) evaluation that are applied to knowledge bases via Can Read, Cannot Read, Can Contribute, or Cannot Contribute. Scripted criteria are cached at session level only (not application level), causing performance degradation. They are harder to audit since an administrator cannot easily determine who matches a scripted condition without running it. Scripts may also contain logic bugs that inadvertently grant or deny access.
name: cstaces-11u uc-scripted-on-kb
resolution_details: Review each scripted user criteria applied to KBs. Where possible, replace scripted criteria with field-based criteria by extending the user_criteria table with custom fields. If scripts are necessary, ensure they are well-documented, tested, and include error handling that defaults to deny access.
